ops.text: e. Client Ownership. Client retains all right, title and interest in and to the Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property, the Credit Data and all other data submitted by or on behalf of Client or its customers through the Interface or the Web Site (subject only to the license granted in Section 8(d)). All results of the Support Services and any other materials, work product or deliverables prepared by TrueLink for Client under this Agreement shall be the exclusive property of Client, and TrueLink hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest therein; to the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded in such results, TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to use the same as part of such results. Nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to TrueLink any ownership of the Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property or Client's data, and no item is jointly owned by the parties.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 2(d) confirms TrueLink's ownership of the Interface but the Agreement never confirms ours, so we have added a reciprocal clause: we retain all rights in Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property and our data, and we own the results of the Support Services we pay for, with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any TrueLink IP embedded in them. Our playbook position is that we own what we pay for and everything we put in, while Vendor keeps its pre-existing platform.
proposal.summary: Add reciprocal ownership clause: Client retains all rights in its content, IP and data; Client owns Support Services deliverables and work product by assignment, with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP; no joint ownership.
